review.evidence: R13 rechecked the native roster, controller code/slots and exact runtime-corresponding token/new-minter/rate sources at BNB block 125834908. The full creation-to-pin role census still has two minters/two burners, all live mapping checks true; custom owner and original-minter runtime hashes are unchanged. Exact Sourcify queries still have no source match for those two named controllers; BscScan retrieval is blocked and the issuer's current unitas-evm-contract tree has no XGLD-specific implementation paths. The 2443 BNB token mint Transfer events, including OFT credits, were retrieved but cannot certify original-minter order authorization or collateral enforcement. Incident research searched issuer XGLD docs, audit reports, launch blog/social-indexed disclosures and Rekt; no realized XGLD incident was identified in retrieved disclosures, but this does not complete the aggregate mint review or establish incidentState=none. Fresh issuer-linked 2025 ScaleBit/SlowMist EVM reports scope USDu, UnitasMinting/V2 and staking/admin files, not these exact XGLD controllers; SlowMist section 4.1 expressly says its audited code was not deployed to mainnet. No sibling audit assurance or finding is imported. Native token code is non-proxy, yet owner can add arbitrary minters without delay. Accountable still reports gross reserves/token supply, not net NAV after borrowed USDT. The previously retrieved 25 September HT Digital letter names USDu Solana and assets held for USDu, not either XGLD deployment; no USDu-specific assurance is imported. Reconciliation and supervision remain unknown and the unbounded-adverse fallback is preserved. Base OFT controls remain Bridge Risk. Native XAUt redemption documentation still specifies whitelisting, 7-day cooldown and 10bps fee, not an end-to-end completion SLA.

unresolvedQuestions: Custom owner contract 0x99997b18733ff4a9d8e0b9c7d9dec59625f87228 is identified, but its executable signature authorization, mutable target and bypass paths are not publicly verified. This is a gap in the named controller's implementation, not an unknown token-level minter census or a claim about human key-custody quality.

Active original minter 0x6e705a2e978a30dc92df69b428a333f6b82c0c0e is identified by the complete role census, but its collateral enforcement and downstream executable authority are not publicly verified.
